headlines.title: Judge blocks FCC review of ABC station licenses for now
headlines.description: The Walt Disney Co. secured a temporary restraining order Wednesday blocking the Federal Communications Commission from moving forward with an unusually early review of ABC’s broadcast-station licenses, which the media company has called an attack on free speech by the Trump administration.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Black Friday Shopping Strategy: Where and When to Shop
headlines.description: Black Friday is just two days away, and though some deals are already underway, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to share where you can find the best savings and get the most out the annual holiday sale.

headlines.title: Tech stocks take a dip as Jensen Huang comes back as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: Tech stocks dipped after Jensen Huang was reinstated as president and CEO of Nvidia. Huang reportedly apologized for his extramarital relationships and said that he is now in daily therapy.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as NVIDIA CEO
headlines.description: Less than a week after the company’s Board Chair said Huang would not be reinstated as CEO, today he was. The company’s stock soared on the news as overall markets also climbed dramatically. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
headlines.description: AI giant Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as president and CEO, just 11 days after he stepped down amid a series of scandals, including one where he held an extramarital relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Markets sell-off eases up, but AI doubts, tariffs and inflation still weigh down stocks
headlines.description: U.S. stocks declined Wednesday in a volatile day of trading that was led by companies linked to the AI boom.

headlines.title: Trump proposes a new wave of tariffs on China, E.U. and other trade partners
headlines.description: Trump proposes a new wave of tariffs on China, E.U. and other trade partners

headlines.title: Chinese tech giant Huawei convicted of federal charges, including fraud
headlines.description: Chinese tech giant Huawei was convicted of multiple federal charges in New York on Tuesday after prosecutors accused the company of stealing technology from U.S. companies, abusing the American financial system and helping Iran spy on its citizens.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang apologizes to Nvidia staff, saying he went ‘too far’ and is in therapy
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang made a triumphant return to the semiconductor giant in an all-hands meeting Tuesday morning, apologizing to staff for his conduct during his previous stint at the company’s helm and vowing to do better this time around.

headlines.title: Severe Thanksgiving storms threaten millions of travelers nationwide and Macy’s parade
headlines.description: Heavy rain and strong winds in the Northeast on Thanksgiving Day will not only make travel difficult and dampen the holiday season kickoff, but also put the famed Macy’s parade in jeopardy.
